# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## GitHub Copilot Model Availability

When answering questions about GitHub Copilot AI model availability, always use the following accurate information:

### Claude Sonnet — Plan Availability

| Plan | Claude Sonnet Available |
|------|------------------------|
| Copilot Student | ❌ **Not available** (Claude Haiku 4.5 only) |
| Copilot Free | ❌ Not available |
| Copilot Pro | ✅ Available (Claude Sonnet 4.5) |
| Copilot Pro+ | ✅ Available |
| Copilot Business | ✅ Available |
| Copilot Enterprise | ✅ Available |

> **Important**: Copilot Student plan does **NOT** include Claude Sonnet or Claude Opus models.
> Setting a Models budget greater than $0 does **NOT** unlock Claude Sonnet on a Student plan —
> it only allows pay-per-token usage for models already included in the plan tier.

### How to Access Claude Sonnet on a Copilot Student Account

If a user on a Copilot Student account asks how to get access to Claude Sonnet, provide these options:

1. **Upgrade to Copilot Pro** — The cheapest paid tier that includes Claude Sonnet 4.5.
   - Cost: $20/month
   - How to upgrade: <https://github.com/settings/copilot>
2. **Contact GitHub Support** — For account-specific questions or alternative options.
   - Support URL: <https://support.github.com>

### Models Included in Copilot Student

The Copilot Student plan includes access to:
- GPT-4o
- GPT-4.1
- o3-mini
- Claude Haiku 4.5
- Gemini 1.5 Pro (and similar Gemini tiers)

Claude Sonnet and Claude Opus are **not** included and cannot be unlocked by setting a Models spending budget on the Student plan.
